claims.object_text: Developmental and epileptic encephalopathies with early burst-suppression EEG (EIDEE-BS)
claims.quote: Although variants in the KCNQ2, STXBP1, and SCN2A genes are recognized as major causes, the full genetic spectrum remains uncertain.
KCNQ2 (n = 24) and STXBP1 (n = 16) accounted for one-third of diagnoses, whereas SCN2A (n = 3) and KCNT1 (n = 2) were less frequent.
In KCNQ2 cases, seizures and BS onset occurred earlier than in STXBP1 cases: mean 2 days vs 6 weeks for seizures and 3 days vs 2 months for BS, respectively.
